Fill your home with festive colour with our Pre-Lit Fraser Fir Christmas Tree. Its traditional shape and realistic mixed foliage create a beautiful backdrop for treasured ornaments, while dual multi colour and warm white LED lights bring a cheerful sparkle to the branches. Available in heights, 6ft, 7ft and 10ft.

This Fraser Fir makes a welcoming focal point for Christmas celebrations. A blend of PE tips and PVC tips gives the tree texture and fullness, ready to dress with family favourites or a fresh decorating theme.

Hinged branches fold down for assembly, and a folding metal stand is included. Take a little time to spread the branches and arrange the individual tips to reveal the tree's full shape, then add your decorations for a personal finishing touch.

Product Features
Easy Hinged Assembly: The 150cm artificial Christmas tree features a hinged design with 2 sections for quick assembly and easy dismantling. Simply unfold and arrange the branches to create a full, fluffy appearance. Convenient to store and reuse.
Stable Metal Stand: The sturdy metal stand with non-slip foot pads provides reliable support and stability. Its foldable design allows for space-saving storage when not in use.
450 Warm White LED Lights: Pre-lit with 450 energy-efficient LED lights, this Christmas tree creates a cosy festive atmosphere. Choose from 8 lighting functions to suit different occasions and moods.
Realistic Spruce Appearance: Made from durable PVC, the tree features 600 branch tips for a full and natural-looking appearance. Its lifelike foliage adds a classic festive touch to your home or office.
Versatile Christmas Decoration: Ideal for living rooms, offices, parties and other indoor spaces. Add your favourite ornaments to create a personalised festive display.

The branches are easy to open up all around to form a full and fluffy outlook easily.
Metal Stand for Stability: Featuring a metal stand with non-slip foot pads, the pre-lit artificial Christmas tree can withstand greater support and balance, securely keeping it standing upright all season long. Moreover, the stand can be folded up to store in the closet. Also, the green-painted iron pipe of the stand makes this tree look more simulated.
450 LED Lights with 8 Lighting Functions: The pre-lit artificial Christmas tree is equipped with 450 warm LED lights of energy-efficient and long-lasting to give a balanced and warm festive glow. Featuring 8 lighting functions, the lights can switch to different lighting modes, lighting up your room with a festive ambience. You just plug into the wall and enjoy the lights shine.
Perfect for Holiday Decorations: The pre-lit spruce Christmas tree boasts warm white LED lights that can brighten all your holidays. You can put it in your home, office, holiday party, and more to inspire holiday cheer and make the season feel complete. Hang on to your favorite ornaments to create a happy and prosperous festive atmosphere for you.
Life-like Tree with PVC Branches: Made of high-quality PVC material, the 150cm Christmas tree is durable, odorless, non-flammable, and non-allergic for a long life span. Crafted with 600 branch tips with exquisite workmanship, the leaves of the artificial spruce tree show a leafy and fluffy appearance and give a full look of a natural tree.
Guarantee - 1 year

Assembly required

This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and wood, PVC, and metal construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Pine Cone Detail
Pine cone details add texture among the festive foliage. Their recognisable shapes help create a woodland inspired arrangement, making the decoration easy to coordinate with other natural looking Christmas accessories.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

The white-and-clear palette pairs effortlessly with farmhouse, modern, and classic winter themes, and looks striking in monochrome white or mixed with silver, gold, and colored accents. These lattice baubles were made to mix: cluster them with our solid white snowball ornaments and white swirl baubles to build a layered, designer-style all-white tree with rich contrast in texture and finish. At 3.15 inches, they are sized for any standard 5-to-8-foot tree. Made from durable shatterproof plastic, they resist the cracking and breaking that can happen with real glass, making them a smart choice for homes with pets or high-traffic spaces, and easy to store and reuse year after year. They are also lightweight, so they hang without weighing branches down. Each bauble comes with a pre-attached white ribbon hanger finished with a decorative metal cap, so you can skip the hooks and decorate right away. The set arrives in an attractive kraft gift box that keeps the ornaments protected and makes them ready to give as a holiday gift. Beyond the tree, use them on garlands, wreaths, mantels, and centerpieces for a cohesive winter look.[INFERRED: Shatterproof plastic ornaments, reducing risk of injury from broken glass]

Christmas Tree & Holiday Decor: Complements traditional glass baubles, lights, and garlands on Christmas trees, fireplaces, mantelpieces, stair railings, and windows.

Handmade Gift Toppers & Keepsakes: Attach finished wooden diamond art pendants to holiday present packages, secret Santa gifts, or stocking stuffers for a personalized touch.

Winter Crafting & Relaxation: Ideal stress-relief creative activity during the winter season and holiday gatherings.

PACKAGE CONTENT

6 x Christmas Wooden Ornament Base Plates

EASY DIY STEPS

Open the package and check all tools and drill gems.

Match the symbol codes on the wooden ornament plate with the corresponding diamond color bags.

Apply a small amount of wax mud into the tip of the drill pen.

Pick up each resin gem using the pen and press it onto its matching symbol on the wooden plate.

Thread the included hanging cord through the top hole and hang your handmade wooden Christmas ornament.
Bring holiday cheer to your home with this 6-piece 5D DIY Christmas diamond painting wooden ornament kit. Designed for adults, kids, and crafters, this complete diamond art kit combines natural wood craftsmanship with multi-faceted resin rhinestones and sparkling gems to create charming handmade decorations for your Christmas tree.
Whether you are looking for a relaxing winter craft activity, a fun family DIY project, or unique holiday home accents, these double-sided wooden hanging pendants add warmth, shine, and festive charm to any space.
Natural Wooden Base: Crafted from durable, lightweight natural wood with smooth edges and vibrant printed holiday patterns on both sides.
3D & 5D Multi-Faceted Sparkle: Includes special-shaped resin rhinestones and sparkling gems that capture and reflect light from every angle.
Complete All-In-One Craft Kit: Comes with everything needed to start crafting immediately—6 wooden ornament bases, drill pen, sorting tray, sticky wax mud, hanging cords, and pre-sorted colored resin diamonds.
Pre-Drilled & Ready to Hang: Each wooden ornament features a pre-drilled top hole and includes natural jute twine/ribbons for easy hanging on Christmas trees, wreaths, and window hooks.
Relaxing & Beginner Friendly: Simple follow-by-number design makes this kit ideal for beginners, experienced crafters, family bonding time, and seasonal DIY projects.

 Front Door & Entrance — A soft welcome that keeps interiors clean

Product Description

 This 1.8-meter smart Christmas tree waterfall light is a newly upgraded festive decorative light equipped with 400 high-density RGB LED beads. 
 Adopting safe USB 5V low-voltage power supply, the light string provides ultra-bright, uniform and colorful lighting effects. 
 Supported by intelligent APP and remote control functions, it features point-to-point pixel control, DIY text editing, custom pattern drawing, dynamic scene modes and music sync rhythm lighting. 

Product Specifications

 Total Length: 1.8 Meters
 LED Quantity: 400 High-Bright RGB LED Beads
 Power Supply: Universal USB 5V Powered
 Control Method: Smart APP Control(iDeal LED) + Remote Control
 Lighting Effect: Full color RGB, DIY custom pattern, text editing, music sync, multiple dynamic modes
 Material: Flexible copper wire + waterproof PVC shell
 Voltage: Low voltage safe 5V working voltage

Application Scenarios
Perfect for indoor and sheltered outdoor decoration. Ideal for Christmas tree decoration, window display, wall decor, living room, bedroom, balcony, courtyard, porch and holiday scene layout. It is widely applicable for Christmas parties, New Year celebrations,
 Halloween themed decor, birthday parties, festival background decoration, shop window displays and other festive atmosphere lighting. It is also an excellent holiday gift for family and friends.
Important Notes
1. This product is USB powered, please use a standard 5V USB power adapter for power supply.
2. The low-voltage light string is safe and cool after long-time use, but please do not soak it in water.
3. Avoid pulling, twisting or excessive bending of the light string to prevent internal wire damage.
✨ SMART APP & VOICE CONTROL CHRISTMAS TREE LIGHTS: Operate this Christmas waterfall lights via the iDeal LED App or remote control. It supports voice control, pixel-point control and wireless DIY design, bringing rich personalized lighting effects for your holiday decor.
400 RGB LEDs with Massive Custom Functions: Equipped with 400 RGB LEDs. It features DIY drawing, text editing, built-in abundant picture gallery and dozens of dynamic lighting effects. You can freely customize patterns, texts and colors to match different festive scenes.
MUSIC SYNC LIGHTING EFFECTS: Built-in microphone enables the lights to twinkle and change colors synchronously following your favorite music rhythm. Create immersive dynamic lighting shows for Christmas parties and celebrations.
MULTI-DEVICE GROUP CONTROL & EASY INSTALLATION: Connect and synchronize multiple light sets at the same time through the iDeal LED App for real-time interactive lighting display. Flexible light strings can be hung anywhere you want, simple to set up for indoor & outdoor use.
RICH COLOR Modes & Widely Application: One-click color filling allows quick atmosphere adjustment. Perfect for Christmas, Halloween, holiday parties, yard, garden and home decoration. The star topper completes your festive tree lighting.

A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

5075660333046.sourceDescription:
Christmas Elf Decoration
This Christmas elf decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Self Adhesive
The self adhesive backing provides a direct way to attach the item to a compatible surface. Prepare the surface and align the position before pressing it into place.

Pumpkin Design
The pumpkin design gives the display a recognisable seasonal theme. Use it as a focal detail within an autumn or Halloween arrangement, pairing it with suitable surrounding decorations for a coordinated finish.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Product details
Quantity: 10 pack.
Includes a 10-pack of festive Christmas elf decorations for versatile seasonal styling.
Features self-adhesive backing for quick, tool-free attachment to compatible surfaces.
Designed with a distinctive pumpkin motif to add recognisable autumnal charm.
Reusable construction allows for easy cleaning and long-term seasonal storage.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Included: 10 x Christmas elf decorations

5056903233446.sourceDescription:
Bring white foliage into your seasonal decorating with this pack of 8 artificial ficus garlands, each measuring 1.8m. Pointed leaf shapes branch along the garland, bringing an open leafy outline and a glittered surface to festive arrangements. The glitter finish adds a decorative accent to Christmas displays, while the white colour helps coordinate the arrangement with your chosen ribbons and ornaments. Lay a length along a mantel, arrange it around a banister or incorporate it into a festive window display. The artificial leaves can also form part of Christmas table centrepieces, wreath-making projects and indoor wedding decorations, allowing the same foliage style to appear in different areas. Plan each length around the space available and position your own accessories alongside it to complete the look. This option contains 8 separate garlands, allowing you to repeat the design across several locations or arrange individual lengths alongside one another. Combine the glittered foliage with plain decorations for contrasting texture, or use it within a wider festive colour theme for your home or party setting.
Glitter Ficus Garland: Includes 8 matching white artificial ficus leaf garlands, each measuring 1.8m. The glitter finish adds colour and texture to Christmas tree decorations, mantel arrangements and festive table displays, with decorative foliage spaced along the length for a leafy seasonal accent.
Decorative Leaf Design: Pointed leaf shapes branch along the garland, bringing an open leafy outline and a glittered surface to festive arrangements. The white colour can be used as the main accent or combined with other seasonal decorations, adding a leafy detail to indoor Christmas and party displays.
Mantel And Stair Decor: Arrange the 1.8m foliage length along a mantel, position it around a banister or use it within a Christmas window display. Plan the layout to suit your space, then add your own ribbons and ornaments to coordinate the garland with nearby festive decorations.
Table And Wreath Arrangements: Incorporate the white ficus foliage into Christmas table centrepieces, decorative wreath projects or indoor wedding displays. The glittered leaves provide a repeated accent that can link place settings, mantel greenery and other seasonal arrangements.
Pack Size And Coverage: Contains 8 separate garlands, each with a 1.8m decorative length. Arrange the individual lengths across separate areas or alongside one another. Coordinate with your own ribbons and ornaments to carry the foliage theme through your indoor seasonal arrangement.

Product Description

 This DIY diamond painting keychain set includes 12 colorful snowman pendants and complete diamond painting tools. Each snowman wears unique scarves, hats and winter accessories.

Quality Material: our Christmas diamond painting kits are mainly made of rhinestones, plastic, acrylic, diamond picture keychain kits are reliable, rhinestones are not easy to drop or break, and plastic and acrylic are strong enough to last a long time
Easy to Use: our Christmas delicate diamond keychains allow you to hang your keychains securely on your bag or purse, so you don't have to worry about losing them; In addition, trays allow you to arrange colored diamonds in order, while glue and drill pens help you stick diamonds in the right place
Nice Gift: our adult crafts kits for women are ideal for DIY, just make beautiful keychains to reflect your own personal style; Using the included tools and rhinestones, you'll have what you need to make a charming keychain to keep or give as a gift

5096042276546.variantName: LED Christmas wreath - Light-up door wreath - 20 LEDs and berry accents, door or wall display for a hallway or mantel - 60 cm
5096042276546.sourceDescription:
Berry details break up the greenery formed by 144 branch tips. The 60 cm outline gives the wreath presence above a mantel or on a door, while 20 LEDs add individual points of light around the arrangement.

The lighting gives this wreath two different uses in the same spot. In natural daylight the decorative details provide the colour and texture. Once the lights are switched on, the outline is still visible from the far end of a hall. A green wreath also works as a bridge between rooms. Choose one shade from your tree decorations for the hallway and repeat it in a small accent beside the wreath, letting the greenery carry the rest of the scheme.

When you unpack the greenery, support the wreath from behind and ease any compressed outer sprigs apart gently. Turn the wreath as you work so that you can check the outline from the front as well as from the side.

To carry the colours into the rest of the room, pick out one detail from the wreath and repeat it in wrapping ribbon, a table runner or decorations on the tree. Even a single matching accent can bring two separate displays together. If you are using other Christmas lighting nearby, try the wreath on its own first. A little distance between the light sources helps each point remain visible and lets the pattern around the wreath read clearly.

View the arrangement in daylight first, then turn on the lights with the room lighting lowered. The two views can look quite different, and a small change in position often makes the points of light easier to see. A narrow ribbon in a colour taken from the design makes a discreet finishing touch if you use your own hanger. Varying the length of the ribbon lets you line up the centre of the wreath with a panel or a nearby mirror.

Hung on a panelled door, a wreath looks best when the edges of the panel still show.
Illuminate your festive decor with 20 warm LED lights and realistic berry accents.
Features 144 branch tips for a lush, full appearance that adds seasonal charm.
Versatile design suitable for hanging on doors, walls, mantels, or hallways.
60 cm diameter size provides a striking focal point for indoor Christmas displays.
Comes with 2x Chair Covers

5096042277246.baseName: Mini Christmas wreath - Velvet door decoration with bow for a window, cupboard door or small Christmas display - Green, 15 cm
5096042277246.variantName: Mini Christmas wreath - Velvet door decoration with bow for a window, cupboard door or small Christmas display - Green, 15 cm
5096042277246.sourceDescription:
Velvet and a bow give this single 15 cm wreath a softer surface than a twig or bauble decoration. Its small scale works on a cupboard door, a narrow wall panel or as a close-up detail in a larger display. It can be used indoors or outdoors, so the same decoration can move between a hallway and an entrance as your plans change.

The small scale allows a wreath to be part of the room rather than its main decoration. A door with a narrow panel or a corner beside a window can take a seasonal detail without losing the space you need for handles and everyday fittings.

When decorating a narrow window, check the view from the other side before deciding on the exact height. Keeping the shape away from a frame joint shows off its outline and leaves the window furniture accessible. For a wall arrangement, try the wreath above a narrow console with the centre of the design just below eye level. A clear strip of wall between the wreath and the furniture shows off the outline and leaves the surface free for keys or Christmas cards.

A simple way to plan the setting is to mark the centre of the intended space with a small piece of paper. Hold the decoration over it, then step back to see how it sits alongside the door surround or other wall decorations. Hung on a panelled door, a wreath looks best when the edges of the panel still show. Centre it on the panel itself and look at it from the far end of the hall before choosing the final hanging height.

A plain background lets you see the smaller details even from the other side of the room. Try holding the wreath against a light wall and then against a darker door before fixing the hanging point.

At the end of the season, wrap the small decoration loosely and leave space around any raised details. Keeping ribbon laid flat also helps it sit neatly the next time you hang the wreath.
Compact 15 cm velvet wreath ideal for small spaces like cupboard doors or narrow wall panels.
Soft velvet surface with a decorative bow provides a gentle, festive aesthetic detail.
Versatile design suitable for both indoor and outdoor seasonal decoration use.
Single hanging ornament allows easy placement as a close-up detail in larger displays.
Comes with Decorative bow
Hanging rope included

Bring a classic festive look to your home with this 7ft Californian style artificial Christmas tree. Designed with a thick, bushy profile, it features staggered branches for a fuller appearance and simple green colouring for a natural finish. The PVC and PE needles are made to help resist fading and crushing, giving the tree a fresh-cut look throughout the season. Pine cones add extra seasonal detail, while the hinged construction helps make assembly more convenient. A metal stand is included to provide stable support and keep the tree upright once decorated. With 1358 tips, this tree offers plenty of coverage for ornaments and lights, making it a practical choice for creating a welcoming Christmas display year after year.
